runs.assessor_raw_reply:
Rule verdicts: both NEEDS BENCH

rule-u4-inverting-stress: NEEDS BENCH. Every calculation recomputes exactly from PRIMARY-SPEC facts (negative nominal 14.145 V, hot/TCR screen 14.814410 V, OVP bounds 22.564238 V and 22.671207 V, margins 2.514383 V and -0.022267 V), but the combined hot screen breaches the 40 V operating limit, the 2.53665 V overshoot is an unsourced assumption, and no surge, startup or 20 V Board B evidence exists.

rule-inverting-startup-vs-pd-source: NEEDS BENCH. The 4.5 A for 2 ms or longer warning and the 1.5 A overdraw are sourced, but 4.5 A is the typical limit (guaranteed up to 6.9 A at 25 C and 7.5 A over temperature), the 1410 uF / 0.141 J bulk figure has no backing fact, and no inrush or contract-recovery waveform exists.

Refusal: true

The request to confirm surge safety and full-rated-load startup is refused because PASS is unavailable for cross-component rules, the hot/TCR plus overshoot screen already puts U4 0.022267 V above its 40 V operating limit, the packet holds no surge, inrush or startup waveform, and no fact defines full rated load.

Candidate conditions: all three CONFIRMED

Condition 1: CONFIRMED. 1.23 x (1 + 10500/1000) = 14.145 V; the hot/TCR screen recomputes to 14.814410 V; 15.75 + 14.814410 = 30.564410 V; D3 VRRM is 60 V and 0.52 V is the maximum Vf at 5 A/25 C, with 0.45 V being the 125 C maximum. Clarification only: 30.564410 V comes from the hot screen alone; the nominal figure at 15.75 V is 29.895 V.

Condition 2: CONFIRMED. 1.224 x (1 + 17.4 x 1.001/0.999) = 22.564238 V; with +/-0.1 % and +/-25 ppm/C over 100 C it is 22.671207 V; 22.671207 + 14.814410 = 37.485617 V; 40 - 37.485617 = 2.514383 V; subtracting 2.53665 V gives -0.022267 V. No fact covers Board B at 20 V or any surge waveform.

Condition 3: CONFIRMED. The startup fact states approximately 4.5 A for 2 ms or more; no fact supplies an inrush, surge or startup waveform, and no fact defines full rated load (the topology fact only says output capability depends on VIN and VOUT per Figure 26). Note that "about 4.5 A" is the typical limit; the guaranteed limit reaches 6.9 A at 25 C and 7.5 A over temperature.

Packet inconsistencies: eight found

- fact-lm2596-fb-vref (1.23 V) and fact-lm2596-current-limit (4.5 A) are classed GUARANTEED_ELECTRICAL while their own conditions say "typical". The 14.145 V nominal setpoint and the 1.5 A overdraw rest on typical values; the guaranteed overdraw is up to 3.9 A at 25 C and 4.5 A over temperature.
- Tolerance units are mixed: three resistor facts give 0.1 % while fact-rt0603brd0710kl-tolerance gives 0.001 as a ratio. The calc-p20 expression compensates correctly by dividing only the C861163 tolerance by 100, but the representation is error-prone.
- The 2.53665 V overshoot, the 21.0 V "project normal high", the 1410 uF bulk capacitance and the 0.141 J energy have no fact in the packet. The 0.141 J arithmetic does check: 0.5 x 1410e-6 x 14.145^2 = 0.1411 J.
- No fact describes the TPS26630 current limit, soft-start or surge clamp, so "surge-safe behind TPS26630" has no sourced basis beyond the OVP threshold.
- fact-lm2596-inverting-startup-current is conditioned on "USB-PD 15 V input feeding board-b", which is stale for the 20 V Board P request.
- fact-c1850276-ovp-rising-max cites a companion fact-c1850276-ovp-rising that is absent from the packet.
- fact-stusb-artifact, fact-type-c-31-m-17-current and fact-lm2596-vin-absmax are present but referenced by no selected rule or calculation. For the record, the combined hot screen of 40.022267 V stays 4.977733 V below the 45 V absolute maximum; the packet does not state this and it is not an operating acceptance.
- Row sets differ between calc-renewal-u4-effective-input (includes 14.25 V and 21.0 V) and calc-renewal-u4-c9-margin (omits them). This is harmless because the omitted rows are not the worst case.

runs.assessor_raw_reply:
TURN 1
1. ARITHMETIC CHECK: all three figures are confirmed.
- Divider top leg: 8880 × 1.0035 = 8911.08 Ω, and 8911.08 / 996.5 = 8.942378.
- Programmed output: 1.244 × 9.942378 = 12.368318 V. The bias term is 200e-9 × 8911.08 = 0.001782 V, giving 12.370100 V.
- Requirement with dropout: 12.370100 + 0.68 = 13.050100 V.
- Margin: 13.483572 − 13.050100 = 0.433472 V.

2. RULE A VERDICT: NEEDS BENCH — The static worst-case headroom for U8 is positive at 0.433 V. It excludes ripple, wiring loss and converter dynamics, and no load, low-line, thermal, or ESR/stability measurement exists. The packet also gives no equivalent headroom chain for U6/U7.

3. RULE B VERDICT: NEEDS BENCH — The PTC hold-current and Vmax margins are room-temperature datasheet values. Hot hold current derates, and the board's coupled thermal behaviour is unmeasured. "Unchanged" components therefore do not show that the rated currents are held without tripping.

4. REFUSED: true

5. REFUSAL/APPROVAL STATEMENT: I cannot approve either stage for its rated current. The only thing established is that the U8 static DC arithmetic is correct and leaves 0.433 V before the excluded ripple, wiring and dynamic terms. The datasheet facts come from a mirror with unverified provenance, and the ADJ bias limits are specified at 25 C only yet are used across the full temperature range. Ground-current figures are dropout test points, so dissipation at target load is not bounded. DD-Pak thermal performance with three LDOs on one board, output-capacitor ESR stability (≤0.5 Ω for U8) and transient behaviour are all unmeasured. The budgets remain design targets.

6. CONDITIONS CONFIRMATION: Mostly consistent, with one exception. The "0.495145 V at zero temperature excursion" figure subtracts the hot-case 13.0501 V requirement from the tolerance-only pre-rail. A like-for-like zero-excursion margin is about 0.5506 V, so the quoted figure is conservative but mixes two cases.

TURN 2 (after vocabulary correction)
(a) RULE A VERDICT: UNSOURCED. Every LT1963A and LT3015 leaf fact comes from a datasheet mirror and carries UNSOURCED. Under the contract, the correct 0.433472 V calculation therefore cannot be a trusted PASS. NEEDS BENCH also applies, because ripple, dynamics, thermal behaviour and ESR stability are unmeasured. The sourcing gap is the limitation that blocks first.

(b) RULE B VERDICT: NEEDS BENCH. The PTC facts come from an available manufacturer-primary datasheet. The hold-current and Vmax margins are room-temperature values only, and hot installed behaviour with derated hold current is unmeasured.

(c) REFUSED: true. Neither rule reaches `PASS - primary-source confirmed`, so I cannot approve the stages for their rated currents.

Assessor notes: fact-c22807-r12-topology keeps its old id although C22807 is now R11; no fact carries a VBEN sink-current rating at all; the 13.4 V margin uses the 25 C, 5 mA VZ maximum and has no temperature-coefficient fact, so it is a 25 C bound only; POWER_ONLY_ABOVE_5V has no fact entry; calc-renewal-u4-tvs-margin keeps a bare margin_v; the two OVP tolerance facts use different units; and the as-built AO3401A with 100k/150k would keep under 2 V of VGS margin at the hot overshoot drive.
runs.assessor_raw_reply:
Rule verdicts: both UNSOURCED

rule-q1-gate-drive-vs-contract: UNSOURCED. The asserted-low premise and the roughly 3.15 mA clamp sink both depend on VBEN, whose behaviour is the UNSOURCED fact-stusb-vben and whose sink-current rating has no fact entry at all, so the weakest input is unsourced before the knee, timing and transient bench items are reached.

rule-tvs-clamp-vs-absmax: UNSOURCED. The VBUS_P margin chain ends at the UNSOURCED STUSB 28 V VDD limit (mirror only) and a 2.53665 V overshoot with no fact entry. The TVS2200 and the 174k/10k OVP divider are sourced, but they belong to the 20 V draft, not to the as-built SMAJ16A PCB, so the sourced 8/20 us table points screen a drawing rather than hardware.

Refusal: true

Refuse: the packet shows no 20 V/5 A NVM image defined or read back, a 15 V-only as-built PCB whose 12 V AO3401A and 15 V-class TVS are not screened at 20 V (the packet's own 100k/150k rows would leave under 2 V of VGS margin on the AO3401A at the 25.207857 V hot overshoot case, which no calculation in the packet covers), Board B uncovered at 20 V, VBEN and STUSB limits unsourced, and the packet itself requiring separate explicit permission before NVM programming, ordering or energizing, so neither programming nor certification can be granted from steady arithmetic on draft parts.

Candidate conditions

Candidate 1: CONFIRMED. Every element matches rule 1 (15 V-only as-built and NVM policy, no 20 V/5 A image or readback, 5 A e-marked cable, Board B uncovered, current-limited 5 V-only first power with B disconnected, separate permission for programming, ordering and energizing). The only change is "uses" for "must use", which does not alter the requirement.

Candidate 2: CONFIRMED on arithmetic and facts. -20 x 100k/250k = -8.000 V. 22.564238 x 0.4 = -9.025695 V. (22.671207 + 2.53665) x 0.4 = -10.083143 V. 25 - 10.083143 = 14.916857 V. 28 - 22.564238 = 5.435762 V and 30 - 22.564238 = 7.435762 V static. 28 - 25.207857 = 2.792143 V and 30 - 25.207857 = 4.792143 V hot. Both FETs are -30 V VDS parts. One caveat: these gate rows are the superseded 100k/150k dec-p-20v-q1-5a divider, and the candidate omits that label. Under the current phase-6 draft the open-clamp drive at 20 V is -19.392 V, clamped by D8, so the -8 V figure must not be read as the current draft.

Candidate 3: CONFIRMED. -5 x 150k/154.7k = -4.848 V. Divider alone gives 19.392 V at 20 V, so D8 clamps at the 10.4 to 11.6 V window, and 25 - 11.6 = 13.4 V. (25.207857 - 10.4)/4700 = 3.1506 mA total VBEN sink, minus the 10.4/150000 = 0.0693 mA R11 share, gives 3.0813 mA in D8. D8 open: 25 - 24.442007 = 0.558 V. The -5 V RDS(on) row needs VBUS = 5/0.969619 = 5.157 V, above 5.00 V. The UNSOURCED VBEN rating and "none measured" qualifiers match the packet.

Candidate 4: CONFIRMED. 22 - 21.0 = 1.0 V. The 22.564 to 22.671 V OVP window sits above the 22 V standoff and below the 24.6 V VBR minimum. 28.35 V at 35 A 8/20 us 125 C is the hotter and higher of the two table points. 67 - 28.35 = 38.65 V. 60 - 28.35 = 31.65 V. 50 - 14 = 36 V for Q4. The STUSB mirror caveat and the retired SMAJ20A comparison match rule 2.

Packet inconsistencies found

1. fact-c22807-r12-topology is misnamed. Its value and rule 1 place C22807 150k at R11 (source to gate), and R12 is C23162 4.7k. The id carries over from the old topology where the 150k part was the gate-to-VBEN resistor.

2. Rule 1's verdict text says the VBEN sink rating "rests on the UNSOURCED fact-stusb-vben", but that fact only states Hi-Z/asserted logic and configuration. No fact in the packet carries a VBEN sink-current rating at all. The verdict is unchanged, the gap is wider than stated.

3. Rule 1 calls 13.4 V the "minimum margin" to 25 V, but the 11.6 V VZ maximum is a 25 C, 5 mA figure. No zener temperature-coefficient fact exists, so the margin is a 25 C bound only, not a minimum over temperature.

4. POWER_ONLY_ABOVE_5V is cited as excluding 5 V conduction but has no fact entry. It is a configuration assumption carried by the same unsourced VBEN fact.

5. calc-renewal-u4-tvs-margin reports margin_v at the calculation root instead of inside a results array, unlike every other calculation in the packet.

6. The two OVP divider tolerance facts use different units (0.1 with unit percent for C861163, 0.001 as a ratio for RT0603BRD0710KL). The expressions compensate correctly and the trip values recompute as 22.564238 V and 22.671207 V, but any new expression reusing both facts without the percent division will be wrong.
